_comment: Template for db/seed/firms.json. Copy this entry shape into firms.json and fill in real firms curated from the AZ State Bar directory (https://azbar.org). Delete this _comment key in the real file. Required: name, slug, city, phone, address, practice_areas. Slugs must be unique, kebab-case. city must match a cities.slug (phoenix at launch). tier defaults to 'free'; free tier gets exactly ONE practice area. google_place_id is set manually after matching the firm in Google Maps (T13 uses it for rating sync). logo_url is optional (null until an image is sourced) — expects a public/ path like /firms/<slug>.jpg, e.g. via scripts/fetch-streetview-images.js.
